use_case: Use the estimate request form during subcontractor work-order scoping and release when the subcontractor work order record must identify project, trade package, work locations, contract references, schedule window, site contacts, and insurance status. Complete the applicable handoff for authorized work order, notice to proceed, distribution, change protocol, progress reporting, and closeout duties.
